$comment: Structural ARR v1-v2 contract generated from tt_telemetry::arr_receipt::AgentRunReceipt. Structure alone does not prove signature integrity, issuer identity, math replay, provider usage, or invoice reconciliation.
description: A signed top-level agent-run receipt as deserialized from the cloud `VerifyReceiptResponse` JSON shape. The raw micro-USD fields are the canonical payload inputs; convenience `*_usd` values and `signed_at` are intentionally not signed.

baseline_micros.description: Catalog-priced baseline estimate in integer micro-USD — field 5.

baseline_usd.description: Convenience display value only; not part of the signature.

canonical_version.description: Canonical schema version (`"v1"` legacy or `"v2"` request-delta).

cost_micros.description: Recorded run cost in integer micro-USD — canonical payload field 4.

cost_usd.description: Convenience display value only; not part of the signature.

request_delta_eligible_requests.description: Non-truncated requests in the v2 run cohort.

request_delta_measured_requests.description: Strictly measured requests in the v2 run cohort.

run_id.description: Agent run UUID (also the receipt primary key).

saved_micros.description: Positive-only request delta. For v2 it must equal `max(signed_request_delta_micros, 0)`.

saved_usd.description: Convenience display value only; not part of the signature.

signed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the receipt was first minted; not signed.

signed_request_delta_micros.description: Signed v2 request delta; regressions remain negative.

signed_request_delta_usd.description: Convenience signed request delta in USD; not part of the signature.

status.description: Terminal agent-run status — canonical payload field 7.

verifying_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key. Trust this key out of band.

title: TokenTrimmer agent-run receipt
